# SQ-1600: a verified command sequence for Zork Zero (zork0-r393-s890714.z6),
# reconstructed by booting the real game headlessly and driving it turn by
# turn, checking every reply against the actual interpreter. This is NOT a
# copy of any published walkthrough's prose -- it is this project's own
# derived list of literal game commands, produced for automated regression
# testing (crates/app/tests/suites/walkthrough_zork0.rs).
#
# Derived with the aid of, as a guide only (never transcribed):
#   "Zork Zero walkthrough", eristic.net, archived 2021-05-08 via the Wayback
#   Machine (the live site's TLS certificate has since expired):
#   https://web.archive.org/web/20210508080538/http://www.eristic.net/games/infocom/zorkzero.html
#
# DELIBERATELY PARTIAL: this script stops after sitting down at the Double
# Fanucci table in the Port Foozle Casino, NOT at the game's actual win. See
# the module doc comment in walkthrough_zork0.rs for exactly why (Double
# Fanucci's hand of cards is rendered as pictures with no decodable text
# signal) and what it blocks. This is a documented scope boundary, not a bug.
#
# Format: one command per line; blank lines and `#`-comment lines are
# ignored. A line submitted while the game is at a single-keypress (Char)
# prompt is sent as a keypress (its first character); otherwise it is
# submitted as an ordinary typed line.
#
# The walkthrough_zork0.rs harness injects three persistence checks (an
# in-game @save/@restore round trip, a host Save State/Restore State round
# trip, and a restart-reboot probe) right after the "west" that arrives at
# the Wharf (the 1262nd command below, one screen short of the Casino) — see
# that file's `CHECKPOINT_AFTER_COMMAND` for exactly where and why.
